findings: F1 (major): package.json declared bin 'ai-catapult': 'bin/ai-catapult.ts'. npm installs put the package inside node_modules, where Node refuses type stripping (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING, reproduced empirically) — the installed CLI could not execute at all.

F2 (major): bin/ai-catapult.ts guarded its module body with process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url). v1 executed the body unconditionally; through npm's bin symlink chain argv[1] is the invoked link path while import.meta.url resolves the entry's real path, so link-style invocations silently printed nothing and exited 0 (empirically reproduced via a staged npm-bin-style symlink).

F3 (major): stageScopedPackage left 'prepack': 'node scripts/setup.ts && npm run build' in the staged @r3dlex/ai-catapult package.json. The staged files[] copy lacks tsc, tsconfig.build.json and scripts/prepare-dist.ts, so the mirror's prepack would exit 127 (v0.2.0's incident class through a new hole) or silently rebuild a half-staged tree; the static prepack-vs-files checks only see literal scripts/* invocations and missed it.
fixes: F1: package.json bin is 'dist/bin/ai-catapult.js'; bin/ai-catapult.ts stays tracked and shipped as the development entrypoint. Regression: test/installed-bin.test.ts (bin map + staged-install execution, direct and via bin link).
F2: bin/ai-catapult.ts executes run() unconditionally (v1-faithful); fileURLToPath import dropped. Regression: symlink-dispatch subtest in test/installed-bin.test.ts.

F3: scripts/publish-both.ts stageScopedPackage now deletes prepack (and pretest/test) from the staged package.json — the staged tree packs as a complete artifact with zero lifecycle scripts. Regression: real staged-pack subtest added to test/scoped-mirror-staging.test.ts (npm pack inside the staged dir, assert no lifecycle scripts and dist/bin/ai-catapult.js + skills.lock.json in the tarball). stageScopedPackage is exported for test reuse.

F4 (discovered while chasing F1/F2 green): tsc emits 0644 while npm's POSIX bin shim resolves exec permission on its TARGET file, so installed invocation would die EACCES even with the JS target. scripts/prepare-dist.ts now chmods dist/bin/ai-catapult.js to 0755 (mode fidelity with the tracked bin's 0755), and the staged-install test asserts the exec bit explicitly.

F5 (exposed by the first vendored-driver run after the fix landing captures): the staged-install e2e copied the LIVE dist/ mid-suite, where plugin tests wipe and rebuild dist/ concurrently — it raced a half-wiped staging source (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND dist/src/scaffold.js in one driver run) and passed in others by timing, exactly the nondeterminism pack.test.ts/packed-init.test.ts document. Fix: stageScopedPackage gained an optional distSource option (publish path unchanged — it still packs the live fresh dist/), and the e2e supplies dist/ from the stable dist-snapshot/ the way packed-init.test.ts does. The suite's own precedent turned out to be the designed seam: dist-snapshot/ is the cpSync mode preserving mirror created by snapshot-dist.ts as the last prepare-dist step.

findings.F1_major: Scoped-only publication packs a broken package from a clean checkout. The scoped-only dispatch (reviewer's citation: scripts/publish-both.ts:353) never packs the repo root, so the root prepack's npm run build never runs; stageScopedPackage stages from an absent dist/ (clean checkout: no tsc, no dist/, only the self-contained plugin ensureBuilt steps succeed), warns 'not staged', deletes the staged prepack and packs anyway — npm warned 'No bin file found'. The unscoped lane is fail-closed by its root prepack (the v0.2.0 incident 127 class); the scoped-only retry was not.

fixes.fresh_root_build: runScopedPublish now fresh-builds the root runtime before staging (buildRootRuntime: npm run build at the repo root). It closes the scoped-only hole (that dispatch runs no root pack) and rebuilds in both mode (one tsc cycle) so every scoped lane stages from a build that just succeeded, under one uniform contract. Failure exits with npm's own status — the same fail-closed clean-checkout class as the unscoped prepack.
fixes.staged_runtime_validation: missingScopedRuntime validates the staged tree before pack: executable dist/bin/ai-catapult.js (npm's POSIX bin shim resolves exec permission on its target; prepare-dist.ts chmods 0755) and skills.lock.json. Any miss refuses publication with a clear error — the staged mirror packs with zero lifecycle scripts, so nothing downstream could rebuild it.
